text: One night in a small Oklahoma town, young Caleb Colton meets the drifter Mae, who [bites him on the neck|trigger|a sudden accident or attack] just before sunrise and leaves his flesh smoking in the rising sun. She brings him into a family of roaming vampires led by the charismatic Jesse Hooker, who give him a week to [learn to kill and feed|rules|it must feed]. Caleb cannot bring himself to hunt, so Mae kills for him and lets him [drink from her wrist|images|blood], while [his father searches for the group|who_suffers|families and parents].
